title: 第240章 但这是废物的思维第239章 勇者大冒险
slug: 我在西幻世界独断万古
content_zh:
第240章但这是……废物的思维！
事实证明，教会在狮牙城中的势力还是比较强的，早在海雀号靠港后不久便已知晓了众人的到来。
季天走出船舱时，码头上已经有人等候了。
维拉尔主教撑着把深灰色雨伞站在码头石阶边缘，身旁跟着个穿深灰色短外套、面容瘦削的中年男人。
莉莉丝惊奇地看了眼主教，拽着二师姐的衣角惊叹道：
“他真的来了，预言魔法什么都能做到吗？”
“基本可以，想学的话我可以教你。”
“好啊好啊～”
奥菲莉娅似乎想到了什么不太美好的事情，略一思索后又补充道：
“不过这种东西看天赋的，天赋不够的话，学了几年也最多只能占卜出明天出门会不会倒霉。”
“……好吧，那算了，以后要占卜什么的话，我就来找师姐。”
“没问题。”
“呱！师姐你真好！”
客观来说，预言魔法确实可以预言出世间大多数东西。
莉莉丝早在魔界当公主时就对祭司们的预言魔法有所耳闻，知道这种魔法神秘莫测，可只见过他们在祭祀时进行占卜仪式，平时压根不轻易出手。
当时莉莉丝就在想，如果依靠祭司的预言能力，击败人类王国、横扫精灵王庭岂不是轻而易举？
就算有些东西无法被占卜，那也可以通过某些间接的方式判断出对方的状态，大不了多算个十几次罢了。
可当她每每询问起父王，对方总是笑而不语。
年幼的莉莉丝并不知道这个世界的预言师固然超标，可每次占卜或预言都是需要消耗寿命的，按照莉莉丝所想的方式来预言，很可能会发动一场战争就失去几个拥有占卜天赋的魔族祭司。
当然，如果仅仅是这样，或许会有几位雄才大略的魔王通过这种方式发动战争。

真正的问题在于，祭司们在魔族地位超然，可以不听从魔王城号令，而人类方向同样有预言师，双方一旦展开较量，很有可能还没开打，敌我双方的预言师就寿尽而亡了。
一根筋变成两头堵了属于是。
主教见季天出现，微微躬身：
“勇者大人，冒昧打扰，这位是圣城派来的传奇调查员卡尔琴科。”
季天目光扫过那名调查员，微微颔首道：
“先进来再说。”
海雀号的船舱还是比较宽敞的。
季天在矮桌一侧坐下，艾琳娜等人分坐于两边，主教和卡尔琴科坐在对面。
主教没有绕弯子，将火炮走私案、泰伦斯的口供、以及“记忆楔印”的可能性简要叙述了一遍。
“…我们追查了两个月，线索指向谢尔多夫·冯·威廉，但那条线很可能不是真的。”
季天听完后询问道，“等等，谢尔多夫·冯·威廉是谁来着？”
“他是王国前首相，人称南境之王。”
“哦，原来是他啊。”
季天记得对方当年似乎还想着给自家艾琳娜逼婚，等到自己来王都时威廉便已经退守南境了，还没来得及登门拜访来着。
见对方了然，卡尔琴科进一步补充道：
“泰伦斯在供述威廉的名字之前行为模式没有任何异常，我所持有的测谎道具也没有显示对方在说谎。
要么他确实是威廉的人，要么他本人也不知道自己被植入了虚假记忆。”
content_en:
Chapter 240 But this is... useless thinking!
Facts have proved that the Church's influence in Lion's Tooth City is relatively strong, and it was already aware of the arrival of the people not long after the Puffin docked.
When Ji Tian walked out of the cabin, there were already people waiting on the dock.
Bishop Villar was standing on the edge of the stone steps of the pier holding a dark gray umbrella, followed by a middle-aged man with a thin face wearing a dark gray short coat.
Lilith looked at the bishop in surprise, grabbed the second senior sister's clothes and exclaimed:
"He is really here. Can prophecy magic do anything?"
"Basically, if you want to learn, I can teach you."
"Okay, okay~"
Ophelia seemed to have thought of something not so good, and after thinking for a moment, she added:
"But this kind of thing depends on talent. If you don't have enough talent, after a few years of learning, you can only predict whether you will be unlucky when you go out tomorrow."
"...Okay, forget it. If you need divination or anything in the future, I will come to see Senior Sister."
"No problem."
"Gah! Senior sister, you are so kind!"
Objectively speaking, prophecy magic can indeed predict most things in the world.
Lilith had heard about the prophetic magic of the priests when she was a princess in the demon world. She knew that this kind of magic was mysterious and unpredictable, but she had only seen them perform divination rituals during sacrifices, and she did not use it easily at all.
Lilith was thinking at that time, if she relied on the priest's prophecy ability, wouldn't it be easy to defeat the human kingdom and sweep across the elf royal court?
Even if some things cannot be divined, you can still judge the opponent's status through some indirect methods, which can only be calculated a dozen times more.
But every time she asked about her father, he always smiled and said nothing.
The young Lilith did not know that although the number of fortune tellers in this world was exceeding the standard, every divination or prophecy required a lifespan. According to Lilith's idea of ​​prophecy, it was very likely that a war would result in the loss of several demon priests with divination talents.
Of course, if it were just like this, there might be a few talented demon kings who would launch a war through this method.
The real problem is that the priests have a transcendent status in the demon clan and do not have to obey the orders of the Demon King's City. There are also prophets in the human direction. Once the two sides start a contest, it is very likely that the prophets on both sides will expire before the fight begins.
It is a sinew that becomes blocked at both ends.
Seeing Ji Tian appear, the bishop bowed slightly:
"Master Brave, I would like to excuse you, this is the legendary investigator Karchenko sent by the Holy City."
Ji Tian glanced at the investigator, nodded slightly and said:
"Come in first and then talk."
The cabin of the Puffin is quite spacious.
Ji Tian sat down on one side of the low table, Elena and others sat on both sides, and the bishop and Kalchenko sat opposite.
The bishop did not beat around the bush, briefly describing the artillery smuggling case, Terrence's confession, and the possibility of a "memory wedge."
"...We followed it for two months and the clues pointed to Scheldorff von Wilhelm, but that line was probably not true."
After hearing this, Ji Tian asked, "Wait, who is Scheldorff von Wilhelm?"
"He is the former prime minister of the kingdom and is known as the King of the South."
"Oh, it turns out it's him."
Ji Tian remembered that the other party seemed to be thinking of forcing Elena to marry him. By the time he came to the royal capital, William had already retreated to the south and had not even had time to visit him.
Seeing that the other party understood, Kalchenko further added:
"There was nothing unusual about Terrence's behavior before he confessed William's name, and the polygraph device I had did not indicate that he was lying.
Either he is indeed William's man, or he himself doesn't know that he has been implanted with false memories. "
